stressCheckResultPage-staff.infoBoxConte:
Based on these results, we strongly recommend that you speak with a specialist (occupational physician or doctor) about your condition.
You never have to deal with this alone. An occupational physician is an expert dedicated to protecting your health and a reassuring ally who can offer advice to help you perform better in the workplace.
Please be assured that the content of your consultation and the fact that you had an interview will never be shared with your company or superiors without your permission, nor will it affect your personnel evaluation in any way.
If you wish to have an interview, please contact the HR department and mention 'Request for an interview with an occupational physician'.

As a result of this check, your stress level has been determined as 'not high.' It seems your self-care is functioning well, and your mind and body are balanced, which is a wonderful state.
Therefore, you are not a target for an interview with an occupational physician based on these results.
Please continue to cherish your time taking care of yourself (refreshing and resting enough) and maintain this good condition.
Of course, even if the results are favorable, if you ever feel 'there is something bothering me lately' or 'I want someone to listen to me,' please feel free to contact the HR department at any time.
stressCheckResultPage-staff.stressDescri: Although there are situations where you feel stressed, your mind and body are in a relatively balanced state. Your ongoing self-care may be helping. To maintain this good condition, continue to value your own pace.

You appear to be experiencing a moderate level of stress. To avoid losing balance physically and mentally, make a conscious effort to take time to refresh yourself and pay attention to your condition.

You seem to be in a state where stressful situations are relatively frequent, making it easier for your mind and body to become exhausted. As a result, reactions such as increased irritability, anxiety, and fatigue may overlap. Seek support from those around you early and prioritize caring for yourself.
stressCheckResultPage-staff.catADescript: These results relate to factors that may cause stress, such as your workload (quantity and quality), degree of job control and suitability, interpersonal relationships, and workplace environment.

These results relate to factors that may cause stress, such as your workload (quantity and quality), degree of job control and suitability, interpersonal relationships, and workplace environment. Higher values indicate that the factor may be contributing to stress.
stressCheckResultPage-staff.catBDescript: These results relate to mental and physical stress reactions such as reduced vigor, irritability, anxiety, fatigue, and depressed mood. Overall, a generally good condition is being maintained.

These results relate to mental and physical stress reactions such as reduced vigor, irritability, anxiety, fatigue, and depressed mood. If these reactions are high, stress may be affecting your mind and body.
stressCheckResultPage-staff.catCDescript: These results relate to support from supervisors, colleagues, family, and friends, as well as satisfaction with work and daily life. Adequate support from those around you can help ease the effects of stress.

stressCheckResultPage-staff.selfCareTips: (Reference) Self-care tips for maintaining good condition
stressCheckComment.generalIntro.all: If stressful conditions persist, your mind and body may react, resulting in symptoms such as feeling down, irritable, or easily fatigued. This can also manifest as physical poor health. Stress can become a burden on your mind and body without you realizing it, such as when work suddenly becomes busy or various factors overlap. Please use these results as a resource to objectively reflect on your current condition.
stressCheckComment.psychBurdenQty.high: You seem to feel that the amount of work is very large and it is becoming a burden. It may be necessary to stop and think for a moment, such as checking if it exceeds your capacity or reviewing the priority of tasks.
stressCheckComment.psychBurdenQty.medium: The amount of work seems to be moderate, or sometimes feels like a lot. Please try to pace yourself reasonably and take frequent rests.
stressCheckComment.psychBurdenQty.low: The amount of work seems to be within a range you can control, and you appear to be adjusting well. You have a good balance.
stressCheckComment.psychBurdenQual.high: It seems you feel a heavy burden regarding the difficulty of your work and the weight of responsibility required. It is important not to carry it alone, but to consult with your supervisor or colleagues.
stressCheckComment.psychBurdenQual.mediu: It seems you sometimes feel a burden regarding the difficulty and responsibility of your work. Let's balance skill improvement with rest.
stressCheckComment.psychBurdenQual.low: You seem to feel that the difficulty and responsibility of your work match your abilities and experience. This likely leads to a sense of fulfillment.
stressCheckComment.physicalBurden.high: It seems you strongly feel the physical burden of work (maintaining a certain posture, carrying heavy objects, etc.). Let's review the work environment and consciously incorporate frequent stretching.
stressCheckComment.physicalBurden.medium: It seems you sometimes feel a physical burden at work. Along with managing your health, it might be good to do some light exercise between tasks.
stressCheckComment.physicalBurden.low: You seem to feel that the physical burden from work is low. Please continue to maintain a healthy condition.
stressCheckComment.workEnvironment.high: You seem to feel stress regarding the physical environment of the workplace (noise, lighting, temperature, etc.) or the atmosphere. One method is to look for things that can be improved, starting with small details.
stressCheckComment.workEnvironment.mediu: It seems there are times when you are concerned about stress caused by the workplace environment. Let's try some ideas for comfort that you can do yourself (such as organizing and tidying up).
stressCheckComment.workEnvironment.low: Stress from the workplace environment is relatively low/comfortable, and you seem able to focus on your work. A good environment is being maintained.
stressCheckComment.jobControl.high: You seem to feel that there are few opportunities to reflect your opinions on how to proceed with work, making it difficult to control at your own discretion. Let's try to find parts you can decide yourself, even small things.
stressCheckComment.jobControl.medium: Regarding how to proceed with work, it seems you can proceed at your own discretion to some extent, but you may sometimes feel it is difficult to do so.
stressCheckComment.jobControl.low: You seem to feel that you are able to control how you proceed with your work. This is proof that you are working proactively.
stressCheckComment.skillUtilization.high: It seems you feel that you are not fully utilizing your skills, knowledge, and experience in your current job. It might be good to consult your supervisor about opportunities to try new tasks.
stressCheckComment.skillUtilization.medi: There seem to be times when you feel you are utilizing your skills and knowledge, and times when you don't. Let's reconfirm your strengths.
stressCheckComment.skillUtilization.low: You seem to feel that your skills and knowledge are being fully utilized in your current job. This likely leads to a sense of purpose.
stressCheckComment.jobSuitability.high: You seem to feel that your current job may not match your abilities, personality, or interests very well. It might be a good opportunity to reconsider your career.
stressCheckComment.jobSuitability.medium: Regarding your current job, it seems there are parts where you feel suitable and parts where you don't. Let's focus on developing your areas of strength.
stressCheckComment.jobSuitability.low: You seem to feel that your current job matches your abilities and personality. That is wonderful.
stressCheckComment.jobMeaning.high: It seems there are few opportunities to feel job satisfaction, achievement, or pride in your work. Reconfirming the purpose or social significance of your work is one method.
stressCheckComment.jobMeaning.medium: There seems to be a fluctuation between times when you feel job satisfaction and times when you don't. It might be good to be conscious of achieving small goals.
stressCheckComment.jobMeaning.low: You seem to feel job satisfaction and a sense of achievement in your daily work, and are working positively. This is a very positive state.
stressCheckComment.vigor.high: Lately, you seem to often feel a lack of energy or vitality. This might be a sign that your mind is a little tired. Please try to get sufficient rest and nutrition.
stressCheckComment.vigor.medium: There seems to be somewhat of a difference between when you have energy and when you don't. Please value your own pace and try not to overdo it.
stressCheckComment.vigor.low: You seem to be full of vitality and spending your time energetically. You are in an energetic state, both mentally and physically.
stressCheckComment.irritability.high: You seem to often feel irritated by trivial things or feel restless. It would be good to consciously create time to relax and try deep breathing.
stressCheckComment.irritability.medium: You seem to feel irritated sometimes, but it appears to be within a range where you can control your feelings.
stressCheckComment.irritability.low: Your state of mind is calm, and you seem to be spending your time peacefully. You are practicing good self-control.
stressCheckComment.fatigue.high: Strong fatigue seems to be accumulating, such as finding it hard to get up in the morning or feeling exhausted after work. Please prioritize resting properly by reviewing the quality and duration of your sleep.
stressCheckComment.fatigue.medium: It seems you sometimes feel that fatigue is building up. Please try to refresh yourself, such as resting well on weekends.
stressCheckComment.fatigue.low: Physical fatigue is low, and you seem to be active and relatively energetic. You are switching well between on and off modes.
stressCheckComment.anxiety.high: It seems that worries often stick in your mind or you feel restless for no reason. If anxiety persists, simply having someone you trust listen to you can bring relief.
stressCheckComment.anxiety.medium: It seems you sometimes feel anxiety about the future, etc. Let's incorporate moderate changes of pace and try not to think too much.
stressCheckComment.anxiety.low: Your state of mind is stable, and you seem to be spending your time with peace of mind. You are in a relaxed state.
stressCheckComment.depression.high: It seems that a state of feeling down or having no interest in things you used to enjoy is continuing. This is an important sign from yourself. Please do not carry it alone, and consider consulting a professional as an option.
stressCheckComment.depression.medium: It seems you sometimes tend to feel depressed. Please value time doing what you like and take care of yourself.
stressCheckComment.depression.low: Your mood is stable, and you seem to be spending your time with a positive mindset. Your mind is balanced.
stressCheckComment.supervisorSupport.hig: It seems you feel it is difficult to consult your supervisor about work or ask for support when in trouble. Since it also affects work efficiency, how about adding a brief consultation when reporting or contacting them first?
stressCheckComment.supervisorSupport.med: It seems you sometimes feel a lack of support from your supervisor. It might be good to convey specifically what points you need support with yourself.
stressCheckComment.supervisorSupport.low: Your relationship with your supervisor is good, and you seem to be getting support when needed. A reassuring support system is a great buffer against stress.
stressCheckComment.colleagueSupport.high: It seems you feel it is difficult to casually talk to or consult with your colleagues at work. How about trying to create an opening for communication starting with a small greeting or saying "Good job"?
stressCheckComment.colleagueSupport.medi: Your relationship with your colleagues at work is average, but you may sometimes feel you wish there was a little more support. It might be good to start by looking for things you can help with yourself.
stressCheckComment.colleagueSupport.low: You have built good relationships with your colleagues at work, and seem to be in an environment where you can help each other. Good teamwork is evident.
stressCheckComment.familyFriendSupport.h: It seems you feel there are few people, such as family or friends, with whom you can consult about private troubles or worries. Having someone to whom you can open your heart is important. Let's build trusting relationships little by little.
stressCheckComment.familyFriendSupport.m: You may sometimes feel that support from family and friends is insufficient. It might be good to try contacting them yourself.
stressCheckComment.familyFriendSupport.l: You seem to be blessed with people who support you, such as family and friends. Even if you have stress at work, they serve as a foundation for peace of mind.
You seem to feel that there are many points you are dissatisfied with regarding your current job and life in general. It might be a good opportunity to organize your values and priorities to see what is making you feel that way.
Regarding your job and life, there seem to be points you are satisfied with and points you are not. Let's try to be conscious of finding your own "small happiness".
You seem to be gaining a sense of satisfaction throughout your work and life in general, and spending fulfilling days. This is a very wonderful state.
